description.value: Diner on Six is a no-frills homestyle breakfast-and-lunch diner on Highway 6 in Vernon, part of a small family of three Norman's Diner locations across the Okanagan. The menu leans on comfort-food classics — eggs any style served all day, charbroiled burgers, weekly lunch specials like fish and chips — alongside a loyalty rewards program redeemable at all three sister locations. For a touring cyclist riding Highway 6 through the Shuswap–Okanagan corridor, it is a well-positioned, filling fuel stop in a standalone building.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at dineronsix.com is live and provides address (2511 Highway 6, Vernon BC V1T 5G4) and phone (778-475-5979), both absent from OSM tags. The Norman's Rewards page confirms this is one of three affiliated Norman's Diner locations in the Okanagan, and active menus plus a 2025/2026 holiday-hours notice confirm the business is currently open. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, water refill) are mentioned anywhere on the website, so those fields are null; takeout is explicitly listed as a service and vegetarian menu items appear on multiple menu pages.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone number; both sourced from website only. Address and phone contact_confirmed set to null as there was no OSM value to corroborate against.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible diner on a major cycling corridor (Highway 6) in Vernon with a live website, confirmed address, and current menus.
